cohort: 240 parturients aged 19-35 years undergoing cesarean section
finding: Prophylactic intravenous ondansetron, particularly at doses of 6 mg and 8 mg, effectively attenuates spinal anesthesia-induced hypotension in parturients undergoing cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study focused on the use of ondansetron to prevent hypotension during spinal anesthesia for cesarean section and did not compare different modes of delivery.
